Method of Attack: Backdoor trojan inserted into legitimate software packages
Storing data in a virtual filesystem (VFS)
Running apps and creating processes to execute malicious code
Communicating with command and control servers via DNS requests
Impacted Systems: Enterprise environments including banking, finances, insurance, energy, media, IT, electronics, transportation, telecommunications, manufacturing, retail, logistics
Attack Vector: Trojanized software packages published on official NetSarang download servers
Indicators of Compromise: MD5 and SHA1 hashes of trojanized software packages
Domain names associated with malicious DNS requests
